title: The rest stop
logline: A rest stop off I-5 at dawn, drawn from nothing: the bus idling, a picnic table, a vending machine, one figure at the far end of the lot with her back turned, small. The only time the sequence draws her, and it draws her at that distance.

panels.composition: A highway rest stop at dawn: a bus idling with its door open, a picnic table under firs, a lit vending machine, and far across the lot a small figure of a woman with her back turned, a bag with a strap on her shoulder.
